title: Entity Mention Solr Document
description: Base schema for entity mention documents in Solr (Impresso Project). A mention document aggregates every occurrence sharing an exact surface and type. This base contract accepts documents without an 'id', which is the shape indexed before the v2 importers; documents built by a v2 importer must additionally satisfy sem.root.mentions.v2.schema.json, which requires a deterministic 'id'.

id.description: Deterministic identifier of the aggregate, derived from (t_s, exact l_s). Declared but not required here: documents indexed before the v2 importers have no 'id' and Solr assigned one. See sem.root.mentions.v2.schema.json.

l_s.description: The label/surface form of the entity mention

t_s.description: Type of the entity (e.g., 'pers' for person, 'loc' for location, 'org' for organization, 'nag' for news agency)
